records.subject: Getting your team organized in Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ahmed,

A reminder that your Wrenfield workspace is ready whenever you are -- creating one real project is the easiest way to see what it's for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Clearwater Media!
records.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Day 6 of 14, no first project and no key milestone; three Wrenfield outreaches (email:ee2066cf, email:25f60cf5, email:a162e7c9) got zero reply, and no tickets filed. One invite sent is a mild positive signal, but silence plus Starter plan suggests low unaided odds in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: One quick step to get Clearwater Media going
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

I see you've already invited a teammate — nice start. The next step that makes everything click is creating one real project: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, so it's a short exercise.

If it's easier, I'm glad to hop on a 15-minute call this week and set up that first project with you around whatever your team is working on right now.

Best,
Priya
